summary: One commit, re-checked by the bug report dialog's reviewer. Report a bug: the room kept for the corner button now survives the button being hidden (a phone page no longer jumps under a panel) and is kept at every width; every refusal goes through one re-announcing path, and a repeated identical refusal is announced by emptying the alert and filling it on the next frame. Admin: a failed read of the flagged list lands by the same numbering as an answer, and a landed read clears the error. All items done as meant; each new test fails without its behaviour. Open lows: a pending refill is not cancelled, so within one frame a different refusal can be overwritten or an error can return on a field just typed in; a repeat blinks the action row for one frame; in a background tab the refill waits until the tab is shown. Noted for the pairing page, which has not landed: its height arithmetic must count the reserve from 768px up.
